description: Expired, revoked and unavailable cards give no context: no file name, no sender, no expiry date, no way to request a new link. The recipient can only follow the advice 'Ask the sender' without knowing who that is or which link failed.
expected: At least the file name (or sender) and, for expired links, when it expired; optionally a 'copy a request message' shortcut.
actual: Generic heading and one sentence (expired.png, revoked.png).
suggested_fix: Return non-secret metadata (display name, expiry time) with the 410 response and show it; this leaks little because the id is already secret.

description: Error states reuse the success layout: the label 'ENCRYPTED FILE TRANSFER' and the footer 'Your browser decrypts this file and the key never leaves it' are shown although no file exists. The only status signal is the dot colour (orange to black). The revoked body leaves the word 'file.' alone on the second line.
expected: Error cards drop the transfer label and decrypt footer, or use a clear error treatment; avoid the orphan.
suggested_fix: Render the footer and eyebrow only in the ready state; add text-wrap: balance to the error body.

description: A trashed file gives 'Shared file unavailable: This file cannot be opened right now' which sounds temporary ('right now'), although it will not recover until the owner restores the file.
expected: Copy that says the file was removed or is no longer available.
actual: 'This file cannot be opened right now. Ask the sender for a new link.'
suggested_fix: Reword to 'The sender removed this file.' when the cause is trash.
